quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: at end-2025 the company held marine communication orders of about RMB 70 hundred million, energy interconnect orders (submarine power cable, marine engineering and land cable) of about RMB 200 hundred million, and PEACE international submarine cable operation orders of over US$3 hundred million. In 2025 it won the Caspian AKSCS, NaSCOM2 (Maldives), PASELA (Indonesia) and Matrix Cable System (MCS-2) submarine cable projects; SEA-H2X landed in Thailand, Singapore and Hong Kong; its Indonesian submarine optical cable plant began production.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hengtong Optic-Electric annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: in the reporting period the company's MPO series products (high-density MPO cables and assemblies for data-center cabling) were used in data centers of Huawei, Alibaba and others; its OM4 and OM5 multimode fiber is widely used in large and mid-sized data-center projects.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hengtong Optic-Electric annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: its hollow-core anti-resonant fiber, shown in July 2025, reached loss of 0.2dB/km or less in specific bands with batch delivery capability, and the company mastered hollow-core fiber cabling; in October 2025 it and China Unicom opened China Unicom's first commercial hollow-core fiber cable line. With China Mobile it launched an S+C+L-band ultra-low-loss large-effective-area multi-core fiber project (company: the world's first three-band ultra-low-loss multi-core fiber in real use). Its G.654.E ultra-low-loss fiber is used in nearly twenty national computing hub nodes.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hengtong Optic-Electric annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report, 2026 business plan: the company will expand high-end specialty products, especially ultra-low-loss, multimode and multi-core fiber, and push hollow-core anti-resonant fiber from demonstration toward scale deployment; build batch packaging and test capability for optical devices and optical engines and accelerate R&D of 1.6T high-speed optical modules and CPO products to break into mainstream equipment vendors and the internet and AI compute markets; industrialise 50G PON products; and keep raising capacity at its overseas optical communication bases in Egypt, Indonesia, India and Mexico.
